verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs describe Managed Slurm, which Lambda installs, manages and maintains. It uses standard Slurm tooling and automatic scheduling, with HA head nodes and Lambda-monitored slurmctld/slurmdbd. Lambda also documents Managed Kubernetes (MK8s): preconfigured clusters with GPU/InfiniBand support and automated node remediation, so users deploy workloads without building their own scheduler. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the managed Slurm/K8s scheduling works as documented.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes

citations.quote: Managed Slurm (MSlurm): Lambda installs, manages, and maintains a Slurm environment on your cluster. You interact with the environment using standard Slurm tooling.
Slurm automatically schedules workloads, maximizing cluster utilization while preventing resource contention.
Slurm is configured for HA, so jobs continue to be schedulable and continue running even if a head node goes down.
Clusters are preconfigured so you can deploy workloads without additional setup.
Choose from Managed Kubernetes, Preinstalled Kubernetes, or Slurm.
